notes.ethical_basis: Chobble's social-impact page says it donates 10% of income to the Against Malaria Foundation; the linked AMF fundraiser describes the policy as 10% of profits.
notes.per_ticket_platform_fee: Payment processing is separate and charged by the organiser's selected provider.
notes.managed_pricing: The managed fee pays for hosting, updates, backup tools and support. It does not vary by ticket value, ticket volume or feature use.
notes.self_hosting: Self-hosting has no Chobble software charge, but infrastructure and configured services remain separate.
notes.registration_country: Chobble CIC is a community interest company registered in England, number 17050113. Managed hosting and database regions are separate from where the company is registered.
